nodes.summary: Complex dynamics studies the iteration of holomorphic maps, especially polynomials, together with their Julia sets and parameter spaces such as the Mandelbrot set.
nodes.title: Complex dynamics

nodes.summary: Ergodic theory studies measure-preserving transformations and their statistical behaviour: ergodic averages, recurrence, mixing and the structure of measure-preserving actions.
nodes.title: Ergodic theory

nodes.summary: Low-dimensional dynamics covers maps of the interval and circle, continued-fraction-type maps, flows in the plane and homeomorphisms of surfaces.
nodes.title: Low-dimensional dynamics

nodes.summary: Smooth dynamics studies differentiable maps and flows: hyperbolicity, stable manifolds and shadowing, Lyapunov exponents and entropy, Hamiltonian perturbation theory, and stability of flows given by differential equations.
nodes.title: Smooth dynamics

nodes.summary: Topological dynamics studies continuous maps of topological spaces through orbits, periodic points and recurrence, and symbolic dynamics studies shift spaces and cellular automata on sequences of symbols.
nodes.title: Topological and symbolic dynamics

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
